project.title: Knowledge Quiz
overview: A quiz app for the Mudita Kompakt E-ink phone that a parent and a child aged 3–5 play together like a deck of question cards: pick an age, read a question, touch to reveal the answer, move on. It works fully offline, in Polish and English. It is an internal Order Group initiative, built by the og plugin's autonomous delivery loop.

goals.text: From launch, the first answer is on screen after two touches — one to pick a category, one to reveal.
goals.raw: - G1: From launch, the first answer is on screen after two touches — one to pick a category, one to reveal. (`SRC-01-31`)

goals.text: Each of the three categories holds 50 questions in Polish and English, all reviewed by the product owner before release.
goals.raw: - G2: Each of the three categories holds 50 questions in Polish and English, all reviewed by the product owner before release. (`DEC-26`, `DEC-27`, `DEC-29`)

goals.text: On the Mudita Kompakt the core scenario runs without animation; the answer appears within 1 s of a touch and the category screen within 3 s of launch.
goals.raw: - G3: On the Mudita Kompakt the core scenario runs without animation; the answer appears within 1 s of a touch and the category screen within 3 s of launch. (`SRC-01-26`, `DEC-08`, `Q26`)

goals.text: Every story is delivered by the delivery loop with its unit and e2e tests green on the emulator.
goals.raw: - G4: Every story is delivered by the delivery loop with its unit and e2e tests green on the emulator. (`SRC-03-03`, `DEC-15`, `DEC-18`)

head: Actor
Who they are
How they sign in
Access, in short
rows: Parent
The adult playing with the child; reads questions aloud and leads the game
No sign-in

Child
A child aged 3–5 playing with the parent; may tap through the cards themselves
No sign-in
The whole app, same as the parent

head: Term
Means exactly
rows: Age category
A group of questions for children of a given minimum age; v1 has 3+, 4+ and 5+
Card
One question with its single correct answer, shown alone on the screen
Deck
All cards of one age category, in the shuffled order the app goes through without repeats
Reveal
The touch on a card that shows the answer below the question
Continue entry
The entry above the category list that returns to the last-used category at its next unseen card
End card
The card shown after the last card of a deck, offering a new shuffle or the categories
Content
The questions, answers and illustrations shipped inside the app, in Polish and English
E-ink
The black-and-white electronic-paper screen of the Mudita Kompakt, with slow refresh
Delivery loop
The og plugin's autonomous delivery process (`/og:deliver`) that builds the stories
